__RATINGS_ARE_ESTIMATES: IMPORTANT. The 29 sub-stat ratings in this file are ESTIMATES, calibrated by hand against public tournament results. They are not measured data and no such data exists. Only the following fields are factual: pr, pr_rank, org, region, age band, and the tournament record described in each note. Everything else is one person's read of how these players play, written to make the simulation behave sensibly.
__PRIVACY_RULES: Players are keyed by GAMERTAG - that is their competitive identity. `real_name` appears ONLY where the player is an adult and the name is publicly documented. Under-18 players have NO name and NO birthdate, only an age. No player in this file is given an `ego` or any other personality-defect rating; those are for generated fictional players only.
__PEAK: Only `peak_overall` is authored here. The engine derives a per-sub-stat ceiling from it (see realPlayers.ts -> derivePeak), so the peak of each individual sub-stat is a consequence of the design, not another number to maintain. Peak is hidden in the UI by exactly the same rule as every other player.
__FREE_AGENTS: An entry with `org: null` is a FREE AGENT: it sits on the transfer market with no buyout and no contract, though the reputation gate still applies. Th0masHD is the only one left after the August 2026 research pass, and it is his real status, not a gap in the data: he left Virtus.pro on 3 August 2026 (joined 21 January 2026, alongside FoCuS) and is listed teamless. An earlier version of this note justified it by his career earnings split, which was the wrong reason for the right answer - what makes him a free agent is the VP exit, three weeks before this snapshot.
__POTENTIAL: `peak_overall` IS the potential system - there is no second one. It was set in one pass on 2026-08-28 from verified ages plus each career record, on this ladder of remaining overall headroom: age 15 about +4.8, age 17 about +3.2, age 18 about +2.2, age 19 about +1.2, age 20 about +0.5, age 21 about +0.3, age 22 and over nothing. Each player is then adjusted for how much of their gap is Big Stage Nerve - earned only at LANs, never trainable - versus trainable skill, and every one carries a `potential_note` arguing their number. The ladder agrees with balance.json -> progression, which sets peakAge 20, declineStartAge 22 and retirementAgeMin 24.
__SOURCES: Ages, orgs, duos and real names verified August 2026 against Liquipedia, Esports Earnings, Esports Charts and the FNCS 2026 roster reporting. Every age in this file is sourced - no placeholders remain. The 29 sub-stat ratings are still estimates; no public source measures them.

settings.__doc: How the real reference players behave as signings. They are all under contract at their real orgs, so prising one loose costs a buyout on top of their wage. Tune these to make the top of the scene more or less reachable.
settings.__salaryMultiplier: Applied on top of the normal salary curve in balance.json. These are the 17 best players alive, so the curve already makes them expensive.
settings.__buyoutMultiplier: Buyout = weekly salary * this. Much steeper than the 8-20 a generated player asks, because none of these orgs want to sell. Lower it if you want a superteam to be achievable early.
settings.__minReputationToSign: Your org must be at least this famous before a top-17 player will take the call at all. It applies to the free agents in this file too - no buyout to pay does not mean they will answer a nobody. Set to 0 to let a week-1 nobody sign the world champion.
settings.__minTierEntered: The real orgs only bother entering events of this tier or above. Tier 1 is the Open Practice Cup - the best duos in the world are not playing that, so you get the lower rungs of the ladder to yourself.
settings.__internationalFromTier: At this tier and above the event is treated as INTERNATIONAL: every real org enters regardless of region, so the FNCS Grand Finals puts you in a lobby with Falcons and BIG at the same time. Below it you only meet the orgs based in your own region.
settings.__scoutLevelAtStart: These players are public figures - everyone already knows roughly how good they are, so they start partly scouted instead of totally unknown.
